name: lattice-editor
description: Live editor + validator + topology visualiser for Lattice documents (editor.lattice-spec.org).

scripts.test: npm run test:conformance && npm run test:unit && npm run test:control && npm run test:resolve && npm run test:merge && npm run test:transform && npm run test:graph
scripts.build:ref: tsc src/control-engine.ts src/control-result-engine.ts src/control-v0_4-engine.ts src/control-result-v0_4-engine.ts src/resolve-engine.ts src/merge-engine.ts src/transform-engine.ts src/graph/eval.ts src/graph/layout.ts src/graph/inspector-model.ts --outDir scripts/.gen --module esnext --target es2020 --moduleResolution bundler --skipLibCheck
scripts.test:control: node --test scripts/control-engine.test.mjs scripts/control-conformance.test.mjs scripts/control-result-engine.test.mjs scripts/control-result-conformance.test.mjs scripts/control-v0_4-engine.test.mjs scripts/schedule-v0_4-conformance.test.mjs scripts/schema-v0_4.test.mjs scripts/protobuf-compat.test.mjs scripts/protobuf-v0_4-compat.test.mjs
